applies_at.description: Every stage the condition applies at, at least one. eligibility: what the bidder must be or hold before bidding (prequalification, an invited list, plan-taker registration, a licence, experience, bonding capacity, a certificate held at closing, obtaining the standard documents the tender relies on). bid_submission: what must be in the bid (signed form, bid security, forms, declarations, subcontractor list, schedule or work plan) and how it is priced (currency, every item priced, optional work priced, whether taxes are included in the bid prices; tax registration and invoicing after award are payment terms). bidding_period: a rule the bidder follows before closing (attend a mandatory meeting or site visit, keep the bid open for the stated days). award: what the successful bidder delivers or does after award and before the contract is signed (the bonds, insurance proof, clearance letter, baseline schedule, signing). Anything after signing, including starting work, is an obligation, not a condition. Select every stage that applies.
